judge_section_notes: Remote shut-off is mandated for all new units at 12 months and for installed units at 36 months, which mainly burdens Northwind (38% current coverage) and favours Halcyon (81%). Suppression applies only to new units after 24 months with no retrofit, favouring Northwind's lower per-unit cost. The 5% thermal limit is delayed until protocols are harmonized, and the reporting and recall provisions are strict, which exposes both companies' unreported incidents.
